description: Layout seam for the codex-arxiv acquisition server. The arXiv id is the ONLY stable key; everything below is fluid and re-pointable WITHOUT touching server code. 'staging_root' is relative to the repo root unless absolute; paths under 'layout' are relative to 'staging_root'. Edit this file (not arxiv.ps1) when the on-disk staging convention moves.

placeholders.{idv}: versioned arXiv id, e.g. 2008.10579v1 (filesystem-sanitized; '/' in old-style ids becomes '_')
placeholders.{slug}: the 'slug' template below, expanded then sanitized

_notes: Every key under 'layout' except 'dir' and 'metadata' is a stageable ARTIFACT. The fetch tool's artifact types (pdf | source | html) map to these keys; the download URL per type is fixed in code (arxiv.org/pdf, export.arxiv.org/e-print, arxiv.org/html), only the on-disk path is configured here. Add a new key here + a registry entry in arxiv.ps1 to support a new artifact type.

'source' is the arXiv e-print package — normally a gzip tarball of the LaTeX (.tex/.bbl/figures); the richest input for math papers. A PDF-only submission has no source and fetch reports it unavailable. 'html' is arXiv's native HTML5 (MathML), only present for papers that compiled since ~late 2023 — fetch reports 404s as unavailable rather than saving an error page.

Metadata is named '{slug}.arxiv.json' (NOT '{slug}.json') on purpose, so a staged paper never trips the membrane's {slug}/{slug}.json raw-IR discovery before a converter has produced an actual IR. If you switch metadata to a bare '.json', move staging_root outside the membrane's -Root (ingestion).
